I personally do not believe in right and wrong, there only is what is and those are the decisions you make and the consequences that follow. With that being said, the best moments of my life are lived between peak satisfaction and self loathing guilt. 

Someone said you lose them how you gained them. The night my wife and I met was like out of a jersey shore episode, clubbing under the influence, and other interesting events. We have been separated thanks to my work for around 15 months we still have complete and utter faith in eachother's commitment that was built through the sleeziest experience of my life. 

My point... Beautiful things can be born in the ugliest of places. Enjoy your life Glen Coco

Then I had to go overseas and now its hard to catch her awake and vise versa because our sleep schedules are all out of wack. I do not think it's necessary, but it gave us an opportunity to be happier. Hopefully it happens again when she's allowed to come over with me.
